name: lower
expr: r1 = double(strcmp(lower("Hello World"), "hello world")); r2 = double(strcmp(lower("XYZ"), "xyz")); r3 = double(strcmp(lower("AbCdEf"), "abcdef")); r4 = double(strlength(lower("Hello"))); c = lower({'AbC','XyZ'}); nc = numel(c); ce1 = double(c{1}(1)); ce2 = double(c{2}(3));
comment: Sig: r = lower(...). DEEP-PROBE 2026-05-31: added CELL-ARRAY support (was throwing 'Not a char array'); applies element-wise -> cell of char vectors, same shape: lower({'AbC','XyZ'})={'abc','xyz'}. Scalar char/string path unchanged. FP uses strcmp booleans + cell char codes.
